_readme: Settings for the store apps. Change them here, commit, and run the build workflows again (they run scripts/configure.mjs). Until real AdMob ids are filled in, the apps show Google's test ads, which earn nothing. RevenueCat keys are the public SDK keys (appl_... and goog_...), not secret.

trackingText.en: This lets the game show you ads that fit you better. You can say no and still play everything.
trackingText.zh-Hans: 允许后，游戏里的广告会更贴合你的兴趣。不允许也能玩全部内容。
trackingText.es: Así el juego puede mostrarte anuncios más acordes a ti. Puedes decir que no y seguir jugando a todo.
trackingText.pt-BR: Assim o jogo pode mostrar anúncios mais a sua cara. Você pode recusar e continuar jogando tudo.
trackingText.ja: 許可すると、あなたに合った広告が表示されやすくなります。許可しなくても、すべて遊べます。
trackingText.ko: 허용하면 나에게 더 맞는 광고가 표시돼요. 허용하지 않아도 모든 콘텐츠를 즐길 수 있어요.
